However, the student did not verbalize or demonstrate clear consideration of differential diagnoses or propose a framework for diagnostic reasoning. The lack of physical exam is a major detractor.

feedback_summary: The student demonstrated strong interpersonal skills and effectively gathered a detailed history. Key areas for improvement include: 1) Verbalizing and demonstrating clinical reasoning (differentials). 2) Performing and integrating a focused physical exam. 3) Using more reflective listening to ensure patient feels heard. 4) Stronger signposting between interview sections to improve flow and orientation. The student should also ensure closure includes safety netting. The session was a good start, but needs work on clinical reasoning and physical exam skills to pass.
